verdicts.rationale: REST v2 collections/create API accepts consistencyLevel as a top-level JSON field but silently ignores it (no validation, no application). Source code shows CollectionReq struct has no ConsistencyLevel field, only Params map. Validation exists only for httpReq.Params['consistencyLevel'] (handler_v2.go:2009-2021). Top-level field bypasses validation entirely, violating contract's enum constraint. Invalid value 'INVALID_LEVEL' should be rejected with error code 1100, but returns HTTP 200. Describe API confirms collection was created with default 'Bounded' level, proving silent ignore. Matches blindspot pattern: REST v2 parameter handling inconsistency.
